claim: A visitor to the McPherson farm recalled that on the morning of July 5 the barn above and below, the wagon shed, the tenant house, the pig sty and the open barnyard were all crowded with badly wounded soldiers.

source.edition: Cultural Landscape Report for First Day - Union 1st Corps Battlefield, Gettysburg National Military Park (2021)

quote: On the morning of July 5, a visitor to the farm recalled, …I found that the barn above and below, the wagon shed, the tenant house, the pig sty and the open barnyard were all crowded with badly wounded soldiers and I the only sound bodied man among them

value.text: barn above and below, wagon shed, tenant house, pig sty and open barnyard all crowded with badly wounded soldiers; no count is printed

claim: The Patriot Daughters of Lancaster recall the Seminary hospital as white tents beneath the spreading branches of beautiful trees in which their wounded lay.

source.edition: Hospital scenes after the battle of Gettysburg, July 1863, by the Patriot Daughters of Lancaster (Lancaster: Daily Inquirer Steam Job Print, 1864; title page read)

quote: my thoughts reverted to the Seminary hospital, to the white tents beneath the spreading branches of beautiful trees in which their wounded lay

claim: At the Seminary hospital the main building was full and the grounds were covered with tents, each containing six iron bedsteads with good bed and bedding.

source.edition: Hospital scenes after the battle of Gettysburg, July 1863, by the Patriot Daughters of Lancaster (Lancaster: Daily Inquirer Steam Job Print, 1864; title page read)

quote: The main building was full, and the grounds were covered with tents, each one containing six iron bedsteads with good bed and bedding

data.item: tents of six iron bedsteads each on the grounds, beside the main building full of wounded

inference: The same writers expect the church hospital to be removed to the Seminary, then describe the hospital to which it was moved as a full main building with its grounds covered by tents of six iron bedsteads, and elsewhere recall the Seminary hospital as white tents under spreading trees: the two descriptions are read as one place.

scene.may_show: On the Seminary grounds under the trees white tents each holding six iron bedsteads with bedding, beside the main building full of wounded of both armies.
